notes.title: Final stretch
notes.content:
Hello, Operators.

The Administration reports: development has entered the final stretch. Release date announcement is imminent.

We are a two-dev indie team. Your participation matters. Extra eyes expose what ours miss. Your reports help us lock down stability, surface edge cases, and tune pacing, difficulty, and performance. Every clear ticket shortens the road to launch.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045092/22676ed6062f6b63c47f61a3d3436659578caf77.png"]
Closed playtest requests are now open on Discord. 

Entry condition: commit to actionable feedback in the designated channels. Include build number, steps to reproduce, expected versus actual result, and system specs. Screenshots or short video help.

Apply via Discord. Stand by for the date announcement. Proceed.

The descent is about to begin.
See you very soon.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045092/b62d8919d7e2fb8d2b9c929d3b20e8927406313b.jpg"]

notes.title: Tiny Teams Fest 2025
notes.content:
Hey Operators,

We’re incredibly happy to announce that Below, Rusted Gods has been selected to be part of Tiny Teams 2025! 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045092/adb2cd4b1c03b2f37e1edf4d1a6c806b7f7ad620.png"]

FInd more about the event here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/sale/TinyTeams2025



For those who don’t know, Tiny Teams is a festival organized by Yogscast to celebrate games made by small indie teams, we’re just two devs from Argentina doing our best to bring BRG to life. So being included alongside so many amazing projects is a true honor.


Thank you so much for being here and supporting us. Whether you played the demo, joined the Discord, or just hit wishlist— it all helps more than you know.


We’ll keep working hard to deliver something we hope you’ll love.


– Ari & Alexis
From South Games

notes.title: New Trailer Incoming – May 25th
notes.content:
Hello, Operators.

We're entering a very exciting phase of Below, Rusted Gods, and we wanted to bring you some updates.

In just 5 days, Below, Rusted Gods will be featured at the OTK Games Expo. We'll be revealing a brand-new trailer with exclusive footage showcasing what's to come in the final version of the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045092/f12f569710d92968264df24e56e513e128d8d7b6.gif

But that's just the beginning.

We're currently polishing the last major systems and preparing to start closed playtesting. This will be the first step toward a larger public playtest, with the goal of launching as stable, balanced, and immersive an experience as possible.

We've also been implementing quality of life improvements, including some requested visual settings, achievements and collectibles to reward exploration and ongoing work on localization to ensure players from all regions can join the operation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045092/8b165fcb56dcd66dad38e89bc89bbd93495089b8.png

There's still more to do, but we're deep into the final stretch. BRG is becoming a reality, and we couldn't be more excited to share what we've built with passion.

If you've wishlisted the game, shared it with friends, sent kind words, or left feedback on the demo: thank you. Every bit of support makes a difference. We're just two indie devs, and we feel incredibly lucky to have such an amazing community around this project.

And if you haven't yet, don't forget we have a Discord, where we talk directly with players and turn your feedback into improvements.

The descent continues.
See you May 25th.

—The Administration

notes.title: Devlog: Development Update on Below, Rusted Gods
notes.content:
Hello, Operators.

We want to share an update on Below, Rusted Gods. We've been working passionately on the game for over a year now, and while we've made great progress, we've also seen incredible traction and received overwhelmingly positive feedback. 
This has inspired us to expand the project beyond our initial vision, ensuring we deliver an experience that fully lives up to its potential.

That's why we've decided to delay the release date slightly. We know this might be frustrating for those eagerly awaiting the game, but we want to assure you that this extra time will allow us to refine every detail and deliver the best possible experience. We don't want to rush things and release something that doesn't fully meet our expectations.

Our goal remains the same: to create an immersive, unsettling, and high-quality horror experience. This delay gives us the opportunity to fine-tune details, optimize mechanics, and ensure the atmosphere is truly unique.

We truly appreciate your patience and support. We know you're excited to play, and we want you to know that we're working hard to make the wait worthwhile.

We'll continue sharing updates and progress, so stay tuned. Thank you for your incredible support.

Development Progress

We also want to take this opportunity to share some of the things we've been working on recently:

Improved Interaction: We've refined how the operator interacts with various electronic elements and support systems within the mission. We want every action to have weight and for the operator to feel truly essential to the expedition.

Branching Story and Multiple Endings: Now, the decisions the operator makes (or fails to make) will affect the course of the story, leading to different outcomes. We want every playthrough to feel unique, with choices that carry real consequences.

New Explorable Areas: We are expanding the facilities, allowing players to uncover more about the world of Below, Rusted Gods.
